description: Pull recent posts (both Spica-published and native) and live follower counts from connected accounts into Results, Media Kit and Location reports (Studio and Pro). Supports Bluesky, Instagram, Facebook Pages, Pinterest, TikTok and LinkedIn Company Pages; X and YouTube are not synced. Respects a 15-minute cooldown per account and arms automatic daily background refreshes.

accountId.description: Optional account id from accounts_list to sync one connected account; omit to sync all eligible connected accounts.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

name: results_sync
title: Sync account posts and followers
